articles.title: Stuart from The Big Bang Theory Gets His Own Wacky Sci-Fi Show!
articles.summary: Imagine hopping through timelines with a cartoon pig and an ice cliff! The trailer for Stuart Fails to Save the Universe shows the comic-book guy from The Big Bang Theory on a wild adventure. It hits HBO Max on July 23, 2026.

articles.title: Steven Spielberg's Secret: Why He Loves Aliens and Flying Saucers
articles.summary: Did a real UFO chase in Ohio inspire Close Encounters? Steven Spielberg's new movie Disclosure Day (out now) digs into hidden alien truths. His obsession started with 1950s flying saucer films and his own family story.

articles.title: The Man Who Discovered Whitney Houston and Bruce Springsteen Has Died at 94
articles.summary: Clive Davis, the legendary music boss who helped stars like Aretha Franklin and Alicia Keys shine, passed away at 94. He started as a lawyer and trusted his gut to find amazing talent. His family shared the news on social media.
